before.name: Paul Hyon Kim
before.description: Paul Hyon Kim was arrested on March 26, 2025 for shooting at and firebombing vehicles at a Las Vegas Tesla collision center after spray-painting “RESIST” on the entrance. He pleaded guilty to federal arson, attempted arson, and firearm charges and remained in federal custody pending sentencing.
